advisories.description: Integer overflow in tensor size computation (dim[0] * ... * dim[n-1] * type_size) causing buffer allocation underflows.
advisories.mitigation: strata_control/gguf_preflight.py and model_bundle validation enforce strict 64-bit bounds and dimension overflow pre-checks before native allocation.

advisories.description: Arbitrary code execution via untrusted Jinja2/chat templates in model metadata.
advisories.mitigation: Template execution strictly isolated from OS shell, environment secrets, and filesystem access.

advisories.description: TOCTOU drift between checked run configuration and spawned process arguments.
advisories.mitigation: C1 checkAndParseRunConfig() parses and locks exact captured text into atomic snapshot.

advisories.description: Cross-origin or unauthorized local access to inference / native endpoints.
advisories.mitigation: Loopback-only binding by default, Bearer API key verification, and Host/Origin validation in serve/server.py and apps/host/server/index.mjs.
